fact: Law No. 6 of 2022 on Electronic Transactions, issued by the House of Representatives on 4 October 2022 and in force, gives electronic signatures and contracts legal effect, sets e-commerce seller duties and makes the National Authority for Information Security and Safety the licensing body for certification service providers.
title: Law No. 6 of 2022 concerning Electronic Transactions
publisher: Libyan Law Society (House of Representatives legislation database)
